dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical narrowing from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle, forming a sharp conical profile at the terminus.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Smooth lateral margins without distinct asymmetrical bulges; the right margin transitions into a deep shadow providing high contrast against the water.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Median pixel intensity corresponds to a light grey or off-white tone, indicative of a mature or near-mature epidermal phase.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A prominent, elongated vertical linear crease or fold is visible running longitudinally along the right side of the dorsal ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, elongated linear mark or crease on the dorsal surface, potentially representing a healed scar or a structural deformation of the dorsal ridge.
